current.text: He signed with Detroit for 3 years and 27 million USD.
One expert does not understand the signing. He thinks Detroit could use Huerter as a shooter next to Isaiah Joe.
In the projected Detroit rotation he is not a starter. Isaiah Joe is the sixth man, then Ron Holland, Paul Reed and Daniss Jenkins. Huerter or Prince gets the last rotation spot.
Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation last season, which limited everyone's minutes.

durable.text: His category line has no strong outlier. Threes and low turnovers are his best categories, and points and rebounds are a bit below the pool.
